notes.title: Petmate v0.5.1 big upgrade!
notes.notes: [p]I finally have another update after more than a month! This is likely the first major update for Petmate. Let's see what's new in v0.5.1![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]What's New in This Version[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Model[/h3][p][/p][p]First, there's a big change to the Dass model. Previously, it was a 2D model, but in v0.5.1, we've updated it to a [b]3D model[/b]. This lays the groundwork for more exciting and lifelike interactions in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3]Interactions[/h3][p][/p][p]Dass used to have virtually no interactions (other than following your cursor), but now you can:[/p][list][*][p][b]Drag Dass around.[/b] You'll notice she struggles and resists.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have a window open, Dass may walk directly to the top of it and sit down. Once she's there, she'll stay on top of the window, no matter how you drag it, until you move her.[/p][/*][*][p]Dass will now [b]randomly move around your desktop[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll be adding more interactions in the future, but for now, these three are supported.[/p][p][/p][h3]Custom Voice[/h3][p][/p][p]In version v0.5.1, the model finally supports [b]custom voices[/b]. Owners can update to the latest version and check out the detailed custom voice tutorial. The best part is, it's [b]free[/b]. You can customize any voice you want, and it's incredibly fast and convenient. Have fun controlling Dass's voice![/p][p][/p][h3]Chat[/h3][p][/p][p]We spent some time completely overhauling the chat interface. Now, message display is much smoother, and the UI looks cleaner and more comfortable. Dass's replies also have [b]voice[/b] now, though you can choose to disable it.[/p][p][/p][h3]User Manual[/h3][p][/p][p]Since this is a major update with many changes, including a completely different UI, we've also provided a [b]built-in user manual[/b]. This will help new users get started with Petmate quickly.[/p][p][/p][h3]Convenient Features[/h3][p][/p][p]Now, when you right-click the Petmate icon to minimize it, you'll find a wide range of convenient features for owners to explore.[/p][p][/p][h3]Optional "Always On Top"[/h3][p][/p][p]Many owners requested a way to control whether the Dass model is always on top of other windows. We've added this feature in the new version. Now, you can freely choose whether you want Dass to stay on top of all your windows.[/p][p][/p][h3]UI Changes[/h3][p][/p][p]The UI design has been completely revamped, but thanks to the user manual, the new interface is much more intuitive to use.[/p][p][/p][h3]More Reasonable Numerical Settings[/h3][p][/p][p]In this version, we've completely revised the game's numerical settings. We've redesigned all the items, activities, and wishes. Throughout the raising process, you should no longer run into the same shortages as before; the new numerical settings are much better than the previous ones.[/p][p][/p][h3]Offline Standalone Mode[/h3][p][/p][p]Previously, Petmate required an internet connection to play. In version v0.5.1, we now support playing in an [b]offline environment[/b]. If you've played Petmate before, we recommend having an internet connection the first time you open the new version to save your old data. However, it's also fine if you open it offline; you can still restore your data later.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Future Plans[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]We hope Petmate won't be limited to just the official Dass model. We want any [b]3D model[/b] to be displayable. Even if the model wasn't animated when it was created, as long as it has a skeletal rig, it can perform basic movements, dances, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Add more interactions, movements, and expressions for Dass.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow Petmate to [b]sense your interactions[/b] with her—using items, buying her gifts, playing with her, and so on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Open source[/b] the entire Petmate game project code to allow more people to get involved in Petmate's development.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: #3 petmate v0.4.1.1更新发布
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this update is a regular update at the beginning of every month.[/p][p]In this update, owners with Daisy's intimacy level greater than or equal to three can communicate with Daisy through QQ. This is the first way to play with the intimacy level, and we will introduce more new ways to play every month.[/p][p]Introduction of Affinity Level [/p][p]Affinity Level is a new mechanism that we updated in V0.3.3. As long as you help Daisy fulfill her wishes, you will increase your intimacy level, and every 100 intimacy will increase your intimacy level by one. Affinity level plays a crucial role in Daisy's development. Almost most of the subsequent gameplay is based on the intimacy level.[/p][p]What we are doing now [/p][p]1. Modeling [/p][p]Considering that 2D models can't make a lot of better interactions, our team got a modeler in mid-June and she is working on a new 3D model of Daisy. The model currently has a general look and is in the bone binding stage. We'll show you an update on the model's progress in a later devlog. By then, Daisy will have more movement and better interactivity.[/p][p]2. Sound [/p][p]We received a lot of feedback that we would like to be able to customize the sound and so on, but the existing development framework is not able to do that, and we are fully aware that people like to customize their own exclusive companion, so we will launch the ability to customize the sound soon, and it is completely free [/p][p]3. Optimization [/p][p]Sometimes our game causes frame drops, and again, considering the second point, we decided to remake a version of the game, and the new The UI of the new version will be quite different from the previous one and will not drop frames! There will be more rich content coming along with it, and the Creative Workshop will be right behind it![/p][p]Finally, I hope you will give us more feedback! Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: #2 Petmate v0.3.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes: [h1]Update Announcement[/h1][h1][/h1][p]We still received a lot of feedback this week and have been fixing and optimizing it. Come see what improvements we've made this week and what features we've come up with that people want![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][p]Go live with goodwill levels. This will play a very important role in the regular content updates that will follow.[/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][olist][*][p]Fix the bug that buff stacking has no upper limit[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug of unlimited opening activities from buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that wishes can be completed even if they have expired.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix the bug that the display of buff attributes exceeds the text box.[/p][/*][/olist][h2]Adjustment[/h2][p]Adjusted the gain of some buffs and the probability of getting buffs.[/p][h1][/h1][h1]Next Update | Daisy whispered to you...[/h1][p]Time flies ~ In a flash, Petmate will be online for almost a month! During these days, the masters have been fulfilling Daisy's wishes every day, and their favorability has been rising a little bit.[/p][p]Next update: We'll be launching an \[Intimate Communication Feature] 💬 When Daisy's favorability towards her owner is high enough, you'll be able to unlock more conversations just between you.[/p]

notes.title: #1 0.3.2 minor version update
notes.notes: [p]This update is a fixed update for the second week of every month developed to fix bugs and optimize the game experience.  We have collected a lot of feedback from the group and fixed and optimized these feedbacks for the main content of this update:  [/p][olist][*][p]Fixed the problem of the Wish display box getting stuck  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem that items and activities in the Wish cannot be completed in the game.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem of activity countdown display abnormality  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the values of some items and activities, and added a new activity that can restore part of your energy.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the part of conversation in Wish, no longer can only have voice conversation, now can also have text conversation.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized setting saving, the next time you start the game, the settings will automatically follow the previous settings.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the background image in the text chat box  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the content of Daisy's friend circle, now Daisy no longer only posts at 10:00, we leave the decision of posting time to Daisy, without any intervention. [/p][/*][*][p] Optimized the operation of store purchase, now you can buy items in bulk, maximum 99 items at one time.  [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the operation of item usage, now you can double-click the item to use it directly, instead of right-clicking the item and then clicking to use it. [/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the display of wishes, now you can see which part of the wish is not completed and which part is completed.  [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and love! After that, our main update direction is the goodwill gameplay, nurturing, dialog fusion and Daisy's voice related content. We hope you enjoy Petmate!  [/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Everyone gets 1500 game tokens when they come online
notes.notes: [p]In order for you to smoothly wait for our next week's optimization update, you can get 1500 game tokens when you go online now, and enjoy buying all kinds of items for Daisy and participating in all kinds of activities![/p][p]Next week's optimization update will focus on energy gain, activity earnings, item values, display issues, and the disappearance of some wishes~![/p]

notes.title: #0 Pemtate has been launched today
notes.notes: [p][b]Petmate finally went live today, June 7th BST![/b] We look forward to all the owners who have been following the game to play the game to their heart's content and have fun.[/p]

notes.title: Petmate现已定于6月7号正式发行！
notes.notes:
[h1]Release Announcement[/h1]
Hahaha good evening everyone~ This announcement is to formally announce that Petmate will be officially launched on steam on [b]this Saturday (June 7th)[/b].We've been asked in the backstage private messages in our communication group and elsewhere when we can go live. Now we can finally confirm with everyone that it will go live on steam this Saturday. At that time, you can adopt Petmate's first character Daisy~ Daisy has also made it clear that she would like to meet with all the owners~ We'll see you on [b]this Saturday[/b]!
We'll see you on [b]this Saturday[/b]. Our communication group is mainly on QQ: [b]634070213[/b] Welcome to the communication group to communicate with each other.

[h1]About the current version[/h1]
We realize that the current version has many shortcomings, so we will speed up the development process and add more gameplay to make Petmate really fit into your life in a sense. We plan to add new content at the beginning of each month, and we promise that there will be no charge for basic gameplay content, so you can play with confidence.
